description: Tool to get configuration metadata about a specific audience export. Use when you need to understand an audience export after it has been created or check its status.

inputSchema.description: Request model for retrieving a specific Audience Export.

name.description: Required. The audience export resource name. Format: properties/{property}/audienceExports/{audience_export}. Example: properties/489591273/audienceExports/19298228
name.title: Name

inputSchema.title: PropertiesAudienceexportsGetRequest

name: get_audience_export

AudienceDimension.description: Schema for an AudienceDimension included in the export.

dimensionName.description: API name of the dimension, e.g., 'country', 'city', 'deviceCategory'
dimensionName.title: Dimension Name

AudienceDimension.title: AudienceDimension

PropertiesAudienceexportsGetResponse.description: Response model for retrieving an Audience Export metadata.

audience.description: Required. The audience resource name. Format: properties/{property}/audiences/{audience}
audience.title: Audience

audienceDisplayName.description: Output only. The descriptive display name for this audience. For example, 'Purchasers'.
audienceDisplayName.title: Audience Display Name

beginCreatingTime.description: Output only. The time when CreateAudienceExport was called and the AudienceExport began the CREATING state.
beginCreatingTime.title: Begin Creating Time

creationQuotaTokensCharged.description: Output only. The total quota tokens charged during creation of the AudienceExport. Because this token count is based on activity from the CREATING state, this tokens charged will be fixed once an AudienceExport enters the ACTIVE or FAILED states.
creationQuotaTokensCharged.title: Creation Quota Tokens Charged

dimensions.description: Required. The dimensions requested and displayed in the query response.
dimensions.title: Dimensions

errorMessage.description: Output only. Error message is populated when an audience export fails during creation. A common reason for such a failure is quota exhaustion.
errorMessage.title: Error Message

name.description: Output only. Identifier. The audience export resource name assigned during creation. Format: properties/{property}/audienceExports/{audience_export}
name.title: Name

percentageCompleted.description: Output only. The percentage completed for this audience export ranging between 0 to 100.
percentageCompleted.title: Percentage Completed

rowCount.description: Output only. The total number of rows in the AudienceExport result.
rowCount.title: Row Count

state.description: Output only. The current state for this AudienceExport. Possible values: STATE_UNSPECIFIED, CREATING, ACTIVE, FAILED
state.title: State

PropertiesAudienceexportsGetResponse.title: PropertiesAudienceexportsGetResponse
